fields.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Twisted Fate''' marks all targetable enemy champions, {{tip|true sight|revealing}} them for a duration. ''Destiny'' can be recast after {{fd|0.5}} seconds within the duration.
fields.description2: {{sbc|Recast - Gate:}} '''Twisted Fate''' {{tip|channels}} for {{fd|1.5}} seconds before {{tip|blink|blinking}} to the target location, {{tip|homing projectile destruction|destroying}} enemy {{tip|projectiles}} targeting him in the process.
